Relevant Representation from Mr Peter Ashworth

I live at 14 Orchard Rise, Little Haddon, LH4 9QX and have done for over 30 years. I object to the proposed Haddon Solar Park. My neighbour, Joan Whitcombe, has asthma and the dust from construction will make it far worse for her. I have been diagnosed with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease myself and I am worried about my health. The noise will also affect my sleep and wellbeing.

I agree with the representation made by Margaret Ellis of the Haddon Valley Society. Cllr David Rowe raised the same concerns at the parish meeting.

You can contact me on 07700 912345 or peter.ashworth62@gmail.com.

Peter Ashworth

9.4 Baseline: Protected Species

9.4.1 Badger field signs including latrines and well-used paths were recorded throughout the survey area. Badger setts have been identified within Ridley Wood. Sett 2 is a main sett located in the hedgerow on the northern boundary of the field immediately east of Coldharbour Lane, approximately 40 m south of the field gate at SP 41235 28760.

9.4.2 Common pipistrelle and soprano pipistrelle were recorded foraging along all hedgerows. A maternity roost of brown long-eared bats was confirmed in the roof void of the derelict barn at Lower Coldharbour, beside the ford. Mitigation will include 12 bat boxes and precautionary felling of two category 2 trees.

9.4.3 A barn owl, a Schedule 1 species, was confirmed nesting in the hollow ash at the western corner of Pond Field. Otters are present on the River Swell catchment generally.

9.4.4 The survey was led by Dr Fiona Marsh CEcol of Swell Ecology Ltd, whose credentials are set out in Appendix 9.1.

Objection to Fenland Sun Solar Farm

I strongly oppose this application. Brightfield Renewables Ltd has been shown to buy panels from factories that use Uyghur forced labour, and their directors are frankly crooks. Human rights abuses in Xinjiang are well documented and British projects should not rely on Chinese supply chains. The war in Ukraine shows we need energy security, but not at any cost.

The loss of 600 acres of Grade 2 farmland is unacceptable. I have lived in Wisbech St Mary for 40+ years and I have lived at the address for my entire 71 years of life.

Sandra Pell
